body:
Suresh, here's a first cut of the corporate bulk thali package — you already do 18 orders/day avg, so there's proven demand:
• Price off your existing "Weekday Lunch Thali @ ₹149", with a volume rate for bigger orders
• Built for repeat orders from Indiranagar offices/groups — one fixed order cut-off, one delivery window
• Launch: a Google post + a WhatsApp note you can forward to office admins
Post + WhatsApp note abhi likh doon? Reply YES.
rationale: Merchant already asked ('Yes good idea, what would it look like') — no more qualifying; handed over a concrete plan built on our earlier proposal/their own numbers, one next step.

body: Namaste 🙏 Apollo Health Plus Pharmacy se refill reminder: Sharma ji ki 3 regular medicines (metformin, atorvastatin, telmisartan) 28 Apr tak khatam ho jayengi. Same dose, same pack ready rakhenge. Senior Citizen 15% OFF lagega, aur free home delivery > ₹499. Saved address pe bhej dein? Reply CONFIRM, ya dose mein koi badlav ho to bata dijiye.
rationale: Chronic refill: exact molecules + run-out date; existing senior/delivery offers; addressed correctly when the chat goes via a family member; dosage-change safety valve.

body: Hi Vivaan, Dr. Sameer at Bright Smile Dental here. A quick follow-up on your visit on 1 Apr — your next 6-monthly check-up falls around September, and we can pre-book it now. Shall we pre-book it? Reply YES.
rationale: Refill-type trigger on a dentist (not a pharmacy): framed as a routine check-up follow-up instead of a medicine refill. Customer recall on behalf of merchant: real last-visit date, slots/offer only if they exist, 'due' claimed only when the interval supports it; language preference honoured.

body: Dr. Meera, compliance heads-up (Dental Council of India circular): DCI revised radiograph dose limits. Maximum dose per IOPA exposure drops from 1.5 mSv to 1.0 mSv. E-speed film passes at the new limit; D-speed does not. Digital RVG sensors unaffected. Effective 15 Dec — 233 days from now. Aapke setup ke liye 5-point audit checklist bhej doon, taaki deadline se pehle sab clear ho? Reply YES.
rationale: Regulation change with a hard deadline — loss-aversion anchor; low-effort checklist offer.
